text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d f-a-k-e r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s t-o s-i-m-u-l-a-t-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-y w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-d-e-n-t-i-f-i-e-r c-h-e-c-k-s.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d p-h-a-n-t-o-m r-e-v-i-e-w-s t-h-a-t a-p-p-r-o-v-e-d o-w-n m-a-n-u-s-c-r-i-p-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g f-o-r-g-e-d m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a t-h-a t d-e-f-i-e-d s-e-l-e-c-t-i-o-n c-r-i-t-e-r-i-a.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r f-i-l-e-d n-e-g-a-t-i-v-e r-e-p-o-r-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-i-a-s-e-d c-o-m-m-e-n-t s a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-i-n-g c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-r-l-y a-v-o-i-d-e-d d-e-c-l-a-r-i-n-g f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l t-i-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g h-i-d-d-e-n a-f-f-i-l-i-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-h-i-l-e i-g-n-o-r-i-n-g o-b-l-i-g-a-t-o-r-y f-o-r-m-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e d e-d-i-t-o-r i-o-n l-o-g-s t-o c-l-e-a-n a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-l-t-e-r-e-d a-c-c-e-s-s r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g p-e-e-r a-b-i-l-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s.
